facts.text: A sign on College Road, installed in the late 1960s, marks the historic boundary between the Shanly and Totem Park subdivisions.
College’s record high of 94°F occurred on June 16 1969, June 26 1983, and June 22 1991, while its record low of –66°F was set on December 28 1961.
University Park Elementary, the oldest school in College, opened in 1958 along University Avenue.
After a new U‑Park building was erected on Loftus Road in the 1990s, the original structure now hosts classrooms for the UAF Community and Technical College.
College is home to Effie Kokrine Charter, Watershed Charter, and Hutchison High schools, all serving the local community.
An early 1970s commercial featuring Bob Hamme as “Granny” was filmed in College, showcasing a period view of College Road and Hess Avenue.
